data_gaps.reason: Page 30 states that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain from voting, but this is a shareholder abstention requirement, not a bondholder abstention requirement; no bondholder abstention requirement is stated.

Page 30 states the revised conversion price shall not be below the latest audited net asset value per share, but the supplied pages do not establish whether a below-net-asset conversion price is prohibited by contract in the sense required by the schema.
Page 30 contains a net asset value floor for the revised conversion price, but the supplied pages do not establish whether this is the net_asset_floor_clause contemplated by the schema.
Page 30 contains a par value floor for the revised conversion price, but the supplied pages do not establish whether this is the par_value_floor_clause contemplated by the schema.

Page 32 states the put price is face value plus current accrued interest and refers to the redemption clause for calculation, but the supplied pages do not provide a separate accrued-interest rule for the put beyond that cross-reference.

Page 33 states the holder may exercise the put right once per interest year after the first satisfaction of conditions, but the supplied pages do not establish a numeric annual exercise limit in the schema sense.
Page 32 states any consecutive 30 trading days, but the supplied pages do not establish whether this is the observation_window for the put in the schema sense.

Page 32 states any consecutive 30 trading days with closing price below 70% of the current conversion price, but the supplied pages do not establish the required_days count for the put in the schema sense.
Page 32 states 70% of the current conversion price, but the supplied pages do not establish whether this is the trigger_ratio for the put in the schema sense.

The pages describe adjustment-day treatment for conversion price adjustments and for the conditional redemption trigger, but no clause specifically addressing adjustment-day treatment for the down-revision trigger is present in the supplied pages.

Page 33 states the holder may exercise the put right once per interest year after the first satisfaction of conditions, but the supplied pages do not establish a numeric annual exercise limit in the schema sense.
Page 32 states any consecutive 30 trading days, but the supplied pages do not establish whether this is the observation_window for the put in the schema sense.

Page 32 provides the current accrued interest formula IA=B×i×t÷365, but the supplied pages do not establish whether this is the accrued_interest_redemption_rule in the schema sense.
Page 31 states redemption at 115% of face value including final interest, but the supplied pages do not establish whether this is the maturity_redemption_price_rule in the schema sense.
Page 31 states redemption within 5 trading days after maturity, but the supplied pages do not establish whether this is the maturity_redemption_window_days in the schema sense.

Page 31 states at least 15 trading days, but the supplied pages do not establish whether this is the required_days for redemption in the schema sense.
Page 31 states 130% of the current conversion price, but the supplied pages do not establish whether this is the trigger_ratio for redemption in the schema sense.
